definitions.explanation: the ability to understand spoken language, often used in the context of language learning
gathering information by listening to someone's account or testimony

examples.japanese: {聞|き}き{取|と}りの{練習|れんしゅう}をする。
{聞|き}き{取|と}りテストで{満点|まんてん}を{取|と}った。
examples.english: I got a perfect score on the listening test.

examples.japanese: {電話|でんわ}の{聞|き}き{取|と}りが{難|むずか}しい。
examples.english: It's hard to understand what's being said on the phone.

examples.japanese: {目撃者|もくげきしゃ}の{聞|き}き{取|と}りを{行|おこな}った。
examples.english: We conducted an interview with the witness.

examples.japanese: {関係者|かんけいしゃ}からの{聞|き}き{取|と}り{調査|ちょうさ}をしている。
examples.english: We are conducting interviews with the people involved.

examples.japanese: {警察|けいさつ}が{聞|き}き{取|と}りに{来|き}た。
examples.english: The police came to take a statement.

notes:
COMPOUNDS:
{聞|き}き (hearing) + {取|と}り (taking/catching)

SENSE 1 - LANGUAGE LEARNING:
- {聞|き}き{取|と}りテスト - listening test
- {聞|き}き{取|と}り{練習|れんしゅう} - listening practice
- {聞|き}き{取|と}り{能力|のうりょく} - listening comprehension ability

SENSE 2 - INVESTIGATION:
- {聞|き}き{取|と}り{調査|ちょうさ} - interview survey
- {聞|き}き{取|と}りを{行|おこな}う - to conduct an interview

RELATED WORDS:
- {読|よ}み{取|と}り - reading/interpretation
- {聴解力|ちょうかいりょく} - listening comprehension ability (formal)

cross_references.label: to catch, to make out, to hear clearly
